observations.client_of_kourend: X Marks the Spot is the start gate. The five surveys are unordered. Veos gives two independent, retainable 500 XP lamps and an empty memoir book.
observations.kourend_branch_quests: Each of the five regional quests supplies a distinct torn page. Inserting a page is a separate action that unlocks its destination and adds 20 charges to the same pool.
observations.the_forsaken_tower: Restore the furnace, basement power grid, first-floor refinery and upper-floor pylons in that order. The twelve surveyed minecart stops cost 20 GP per leg before the quest and are free after completion.
observations.tale_of_the_righteous: The archive device uses all three combat styles. The mining and strength checks apply to the cave obstacles. Quest Month adds 1,500 Mining XP.
observations.children_of_the_sun: The roof conversation ends the quest. The first Primio trip records actual arrival in Varlamore.
observations.twilights_promise: The four knights' tasks can be done in any order. Feeding Renu opens the quest flight to the Teomat. Completion opens regular flights between eight prebuilt landings and the Civitas illa Fortis spell and tablet.
observations.teleports: Rune-consuming casts grant Magic XP. A modeled spell edge grants XP once per origin and destination under the current catalog contract. House portals and tablets grant no cast XP.
